title.en: halloween party at the alter bahnhof.

line.en: a halloween party at the alter bahnhof in oberkassel from 20:00 on saturday. tickets from about 12 euros on the listing; check the price there.
line.de: eine halloween-party im alter bahnhof in oberkassel ab 20:00 am samstag. tickets ab etwa 12 euro laut angebot; den preis dort prüfen.
line.tr: cumartesi günü 20:00'den itibaren oberkassel'deki alter bahnhof'ta bir halloween partisi. biletler ilanda yaklaşık 12 euro'dan başlıyor; fiyatı oradan kontrol et.

sparks.why: Halloween Party at Alter Bahnhof Oberkassel (Belsenplatz 2), sat 31.10.2026 from 20:00, tickets from EUR 12.34, per regioactive.de (https://www.regioactive.de/party/halloween-party-duesseldorf-alter-bahnhof-oberkassel-2026-10-31-tickets-80RjzWF3DC) and mvp.de (https://www.mvp.de/duesseldorf/veranstaltungen/halloween-party-alter-bahnhof-oberkassel-duesseldorf/).
